AddImageMember.summary: Sharing an Image with an Account in a Specified Project
AddImageMember.description: This API is used to share an image with a specified account. - Images can only be shared with other Huawei Cloud accounts (**project ID**) in the same region. - An image can be shared with a maximum of 10 accounts.
